lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) is a digital marketing agency that works remotely with Oklahoma City businesses on SEO, paid advertising, social media, websites and video. OKC is the state capital, an energy and aviation town, and one of the most spread-out cities in the country by land area. We plan marketing around where your customers live and drive, from Edmond in the north to Norman in the south.

sections.heading: Energy, aviation, government and medicine
paragraphs: Oklahoma City grew up with oil and gas, and energy company towers still define the downtown skyline. Around them are the service firms, landmen, engineers and equipment suppliers that support drilling across the state. Tinker Air Force Base, on the southeast side near Midwest City, is a major aircraft maintenance centre and supports a large community of aerospace contractors, and the federal aviation training centre by the airport adds to that base.

State government fills the Capitol complex, and the health centre district northeast of downtown brings together hospitals, a medical school and research institutes. The city is also the home of several national companies in fuel retail, payroll software, crafts and fast food. Livestock still matters: Stockyards City on the southwest side hosts cattle auctions and western outfitters, and State Fair Park stages horse shows through much of the year.

sections.heading: Districts close in, suburbs far out
paragraphs: A long run of public projects has rebuilt the centre of the city. Bricktown has the ballpark, canal and restaurants, with the arena and the Thunder next door. Midtown, Automobile Alley, the Plaza District, the Paseo and Uptown 23rd each have their own independent shops, bars and studios. Nichols Hills and the neighbourhoods around Lake Hefner are among the more affluent parts of town.

Most residents, however, live a good drive from downtown. Edmond, Moore, Yukon, Mustang, Midwest City, Del City and Norman each have their own identity, schools and shopping, and the metro is tied together by Interstates 35, 40 and 44. Customers weigh up a business by the drive, and they search using their suburb's name.
bullets: Location pages and business profiles for each area served, from Edmond to Moore.
Ad targeting set by drive time along the interstates and turnpikes.
Different messages for downtown district visitors and suburban households.
Review requests built into every completed job.
Tracking that shows which area and which keyword produced each call.

sections.heading: Weather that changes demand overnight
paragraphs: Central Oklahoma sees some of the most severe spring weather in the country. A hailstorm over Moore or Edmond produces thousands of searches for roof inspections, car dent repair and insurance help within hours, and tornado season keeps storm shelter installers busy. Local firms need to be visible and credible at that moment, with pages that name the neighbourhoods affected and reviews from neighbours.
Summer heat pushes air-conditioning repair to the top, and the occasional winter ice storm does the same for tree services, plumbers and generator dealers.

sections.heading: Events that fill the city
paragraphs: Thunder home games bring crowds downtown through the basketball season. The college softball championship arrives each early summer, the State Fair runs in September, and horse shows and rodeo events draw visitors who stay for days. University of Oklahoma football in Norman empties and fills the southern suburbs on autumn Saturdays. Restaurants, hotels, retailers and attractions that plan content and ads around those dates capture visitors who are deciding where to eat and what to do on their phones.

faqs.q: Does TDM have an office in Oklahoma City?
faqs.a: No. We work with OKC businesses remotely. Meetings are by video call and all reporting is shared online.

faqs.q: How do I get customers from Edmond, Moore and Norman?
faqs.a: Give each suburb its own page with details that matter there, list the areas in your business profile, gather reviews from customers in each and run ads by area so budgets can be compared.

faqs.q: What should a home services company do before storm season?
faqs.a: Write hail and tornado damage pages, prepare ad copy and set aside budget in advance. When a storm hits, target the affected ZIP codes that day and make your local address and insurance details easy to find.

faqs.q: Can you market an energy services company based in OKC?
faqs.a: Yes. We build technical service pages, improve search visibility for the terms operators use and run campaigns aimed at relevant job roles. Decisions in the sector are slow, so progress is measured over a longer period.

faqs.q: How much does digital marketing cost in Oklahoma City?
faqs.a: It depends on the scope of the work. We talk through your goals in a free consultation and quote afterwards.
